jobs.title: Customer Care Ops Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

The Farmer’s Dog was born from a mission to change the landscape of pet health, providing dogs and their humans with honest, smart, and simple care. We’re starting by radically improving the $90 billion pet food industry, replacing bags of highly-processed pellets with a personalized subscription service that sends complete and balanced, freshly-made dog food directly to customers’ doors. Our ultimate goal is to create innovative, delightful and personalized experiences across all aspects of pet care, and we believe our direct-to-consumer business model, holistic approach to growth, and dynamic culture uniquely position us to shepherd this backwards industry into the future.

To date, The Farmer’s Dog has delivered over 1 billion meals nationwide and raised over $150M in funding to help us build a company as healthy as the dogs who are eating those meals. Join us as we continue to develop ways of bringing peace of mind to customers, health to their companions, and much-needed change to the way people feed and care for their pets.

#LongLiveDogs

What We Stand For and Where You’ll Come In

We’re in search of a Customer Care Ops Manager to join the Customer Care team at The Farmer’s Dog. The Ops Manager plays a key role in creating a high-performing Customer Care organization by developing leaders, strengthening advisor performance, and creating an environment where people can do their best work. You’ll partner closely with Manager Group to set clear expectations, build accountability, and connect business priorities to meaningful actions for their groups. You’ll also serve as a cross-functional partner and point of contact for initiatives that impact Customer Care, helping bring the right people together, remove barriers, and ensure changes are thoughtfully implemented across the broader Care organization. At the heart of the role is creating an exceptional experience for both our people and our customers, while helping the organization continuously find ways to do better.

*This role will primarily be filled during our core business hours of 9-6, Monday through Friday, but will require regular rotations of on-call or Manager on Duty periods for weekends, Holidays and extended hours. As The Farmer’s Dog is growing quickly, it’s likely that CC hours of operations will expand to meet the needs of customers. Ops Managers will be expected to flex to work additional hours as needed.*

One Team: We don’t think of ourselves as “Acquisition Marketers”, “Engineers”, “Data Analysts”, or “Product Managers”. Beyond denoting skill sets and areas of expertise, we don’t think departments matter. We’d rather align ourselves to the goals we’re working to achieve and make sure we have necessary subject matter expertise to drive meaningful impact. We strive to orient ourselves around customer problems TOGETHER – getting the right people, with the right context, in the right rooms/Zooms to solve problems holistically.

We are skeptical about everything and precious about nothing:   Ideas can and should come from anywhere, and we aren’t tied to our own. We proactively source input. We talk to our customers and leads regularly and are quick to change course if we know there’s a better or more impactful way to solve problems.

We consider the customer journey in all of our decisions:   We know that no interaction exists in a silo and therefore understand how important every single one is.  We ensure our strategy sets prospective and new customers up for success and drives long-term retention.  We answer questions and address problems early and proactively.  We understand the value of different channels, initiatives, and messages and know how to articulate impact and advocate for prioritization holistically.

We Execute For Impact: We don’t subscribe to “best practices” or “industry KPIs”. We’re uninterested in how we compare to “benchmarks”; instead we orient ourselves around being the best we can possibly be. Similarly, we don’t subscribe to rigid or classical expectations of roles – i.e. acquisition is hyper-focused on improving customer retention and experience.

We Are Focused and Work Without Assumption : We are not beholden to ideas. We have goals and believe everything beyond that is a series of hypotheses to validate. To that end, we seek to work in sequence and not in parallel. We constantly ask ourselves, “what’s the most important hypothesis I should be working on right now? How do I confirm or reject that hypothesis as fast as possible?”. We rarely have timelines/deadlines and are constantly taking in new information and adjusting our priorities accordingly. We don’t expect to be perfect the first time.

How You'll Make An Impact

- Develop and coach Manager Group through regular coaching, feedback, goal setting, and career development, helping them grow as leaders and strengthen the performance of their groups.

- Support advisor development by ensuring Managers are equipped to coach, recognize strengths, address opportunities, and create meaningful growth paths for their Advisors.

- Build accountability and ownership by setting clear expectations and helping leaders connect individual and group performance to broader Customer Care goals.

- Turn performance insights into action by using data, advisor feedback, and customer insights to identify root causes, determine the right actions, and follow through on results.

- Champion Iconic Care by keeping the customer experience at the center of decisions and helping leaders translate our standards into everyday advisor behaviors.

- Partner cross-functionally to improve the employee and customer experience, bringing together the right partners to solve problems and create better solutions.

- Serve as a point of contact for Customer Care initiatives , helping coordinate communication, gather feedback, identify potential challenges, and ensure initiatives are effectively supported across Managers and Advisors.

- Lead through change by creating clarity, communicating the why, anticipating concerns, and helping leaders and Advisors successfully adopt new processes, tools, and expectations.

- Proactively identify and solve problems by looking ahead, challenging the status quo, and taking action before issues become larger barriers for the organization.

- Strengthen a high-performing culture by modeling high standards, urgency, ownership, and excellence in how you lead and hold others accountable.

- Bring people together by building strong partnerships across Customer Care and the broader organization to find solutions that are thoughtful, practical, and in the best interest of our people and customers.

- Recognize and reinforce great work by celebrating progress, calling out the behaviors that drive strong outcomes, and creating a culture where people know their contributions matter.

- Communicate progress and outcomes by clearly sharing accomplishments, key results, challenges, and progress toward objectives with the appropriate stakeholders.

We're Excited About You Because

- You have 3-5 years of management experience, with several in a managerial capacity or a history of continuous leadership growth within a CC organization

- ​​You have a solid understanding of managerial best practices, building training programs, and demonstrated empathy

- You have a strong background in synthesizing & analyzing data

- You are process-oriented, knowing how to define goals & measure success

- You have solid command of CRM platforms and Customer Care tools

- You have an impeccable attention to detail

- You have strong communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills

- You have a strong ability to prioritize multiple projects and quickly adapt in an evolving environment

- You have an infectious positive attitude

Office Guidelines

We are an in-office culture, made of in-office people who thrive on the collaboration and magnetism of working in a shared space. We are seeking individuals who excel in this type of environment, where being present fosters deeper connections and engagement.

Our Belonging Philosophy:

At TFD, we believe Belonging is a shared commitment to creating a workplace where every person feels respected, valued, and empowered to be themselves. When people feel a true sense of belonging, they do their best work, take smart risks, and bring forward diverse perspectives — leading to stronger decisions and deeper relationships.

We anchor this belief in a simple phrase: “Everyone’s welcome at the dog park.” No matter your background, identity, or role, there’s space for you here. There’s no one way to show up at the dog park— just shared space, mutual respect, and the freedom to be yourself. Being included is just the beginning, it’s about contributing your voice, growing through challenges, and building trust through shared goals. This philosophy guides how we lead, how we hire, how we communicate, and how we grow.

We continuously evaluate to ensure we are creating a consistent experience that cultivates belonging for all employees, from hiring and performance reviews to talent development. We also believe Belonging happens in everyday moments of connection; lunch with a new teammate, a shared laugh, or a quick story about your weekend. Our structure includes biannual employee surveys, manager training, TFD camps, and support from Humans to ensure we’re listening and learning from our Team.

Together, these efforts reflect what Belonging means at TFD: a culture where everyone can thrive.

A Few of Our Best Benefits

- Dog-friendly office

- Market-competitive compensation and equity packages

- Comprehensive Healthcare, Dental, and Vision

- Company sponsored mental health benefit and coaching through Modern Health

- 12 week paid parental leave

- Competitive 401k plan with company match

- Flexible PTO and hybrid work policy

- Discounted fresh food for your pup

- Your pet interrupting video calls (and in-person meetings) is now a feature, not a bug

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

The Farmer's Dog, Inc. is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic or status. For more information, please visit Know Your Rights .

Reasonable Accommodations

TFD complies with applicable federal, state, and local disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities.  If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact  humansops@thefarmersdog.com .

We’re happy to answer any questions you may have about the position or our hiring process - please reach out at careers@thefarmersdog.com .

Are you a forward-thinking leader looking to join a rapidly growing organization? Are you passionate about building and developing teams and processes? Do you enjoy working for an organization with an impactful mission and great culture? Then this may be the opportunity for you! We are looking for a Director, Operational Excellence leader to join our growing team! In this role, you will lead a number of key functions that are critical to The Farmers Dog in delivering an unrivaled customer experience. Specifically, this role will lead our internal Voice of the Customer program, influencing key leaders and teams such as product engineering, product, marketing, supply chain, retail, and more. In addition, this role will lead our internal Customer Care Insights team (formerly QA), which is focused on providing our operations team with insights to help improve performance when interacting with our customers. This role will also lead our Planning and Workforce Management functions, to ensure we provide an effortless experience to our customers by answering contacts in real-time, while being efficient. Finally, this role will also drive continuous improvement in our digital product by working closely with product managers on ensuring the customer experience is as easy as possible when managing their subscription. This role will report into SVP of Customer Care. We are an in-office company and this role will be based in Boca Raton, FL.

This role will directly interact with key business leaders, supporting a midsize customer care organization. A successful leader must have skills to influence at an executive level, and the ability to articulate end-to-end capacity planning and workforce plans, lead process improvement, and other strategic initiatives. You'll be accountable for establishing capacity models and processes that support business leaders’ efforts to achieve consistent service performance, accommodate new initiatives, deliver budget goals, and make operational decisions based on timely relevant information. This role will also help lead our QA process as we look to leverage AI technology to improve internal operations performance and customer outcomes. In addition, be a strategic thought partner when it comes to identifying continuous improvement opportunities to drive efficiency and effectiveness. Partnering with other key stakeholders across the company will be critical to drive operational improvements and optimization.

How You'll Make An Impact

- Build the vision for and lead development of a systematic and disciplined team using a forward-thinking mindset.

- Lead the team that supports capacity, workforce management, forecasting and planning activities including employee schedules to cover short, medium, and long-term strategy to meet service level and saturation goals supporting various levels of leadership and stakeholders.

- Drive regular strategic plan reviews to drive on-target execution.

- Identify and implement process improvements to enhance the employee, customer experience, as well as operational efficiency.

- Overhaul key workflows to drive improved efficiency and contact reduction via product and engineering.

- Lead in the adoption of AI across the organization.

- Be a key leader in building effective reporting and analytics for the entire Customer Care organization.

- Drive resolution and/or mitigation of current and anticipated capacity planning and workforce challenges, analyzing and identifying critical workforce requirements vital to execute strategic business plans.

- Identify potential risks when implementing change along with developing mitigation strategies and plans.

- Travel to other TFD offices (Nashville or NYC) approximately one-week per month to build a collaborative and invested environment to foster our unique in-person culture, and meet with key stakeholders to effectively partner and influence other business leaders.

We're Excited About You Because

- 10+ years of experience in Business Operations, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent Management experience

- Experience driving significant process improvements across multiple areas of the business, Six Sigma certification a plus

- Experience balancing customer experience and operational efficiency to improve customer retention/loyalty

- Experience leading and developing Capacity Planning and Workforce Management Teams

- Contact center workforce management experience with support to multiple channels of interaction including voice, sms, chats, and emails.

- Excellent communication, forecast modeling, data visualization and conceptual thinking skills including ability to present complex material to senior leaders

- Serve as the analytical backbone for marketing leadership, turning performance and spend data into clear, defensible recommendations that inform investment decisions.

- Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Data, and every marketing pillar, including Acquisition, Lifecycle, Brand, and Creative, to keep planning assumptions, KPIs, and definitions consistent across the org.

- Lead post-mortems and forecasting reviews on major marketing investments, capturing lessons learned and feeding them back into the next planning cycle.

- Build and maintain the tools, trackers, and reporting infrastructure that make marketing spend and performance visible to stakeholders at every level, from channel owners to executive leadership.

- You have experience partnering with Finance and cross-functional leaders on budget planning, allocation, and tradeoff decisions.

- You know how to spot risk early in pacing, concentration, or forecast variance, and bring structured, credible recommendations to leadership.

- You’ve built or run planning cadences and operating rhythms that keep a multi-channel or multi-team organization aligned around shared goals.

- You have strong executive presence and can communicate complex tradeoffs simply and persuasively to senior stakeholders.

- You’re comfortable being the person in the room who asks “does this add up,” and you bring structure to ambiguity.

- You are able to thrive in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, naturally curious and proactive self-starter, constantly on the lookout for new opportunities and solutions

- You’re an owner, have excellent problem-solving skills and can prioritize tasks effectively, with a strong attention to detail

- You are detail-oriented and proactive, you thrive as a self-starter and excel in managing multiple projects simultaneously

jobs.description:
Who We Are

The Farmer’s Dog was born from a mission to change the landscape of pet health, providing dogs and their humans with honest, smart, and simple care. We’re starting by radically improving the $90 billion pet food industry, replacing bags of highly-processed pellets with a personalized subscription service that sends complete and balanced, freshly-made dog food directly to customers’ doors. Our ultimate goal is to create innovative, delightful and personalized experiences across all aspects of pet care, and we believe our direct-to-consumer business model, holistic approach to growth, and dynamic culture uniquely position us to shepherd this backwards industry into the future.

To date, The Farmer’s Dog has delivered over 1 billion meals nationwide and raised over $150M in funding to help us build a company as healthy as the dogs who are eating those meals. Join us as we continue to develop ways of bringing peace of mind to customers, health to their companions, and much-needed change to the way people feed and care for their pets.

#LongLiveDogs

What We Stand For and Where You’ll Come In

As the Senior Operations Strategy and Project Manager, you'll own the highest-priority initiatives on the Ops roadmap and drive them to completion. This is a role for someone who can do both halves of the job well: run complex, cross-functional projects with real discipline, and bring the analytical rigor to decide which projects deserve investment in the first place.

You'll partner across Planning, Procurement, Fulfillment, Technical Operations, Commercialization, Nutrition, Innovation, Marketing, and FP&A to define scope, pressure-test feasibility, and hold timelines — including leading new product launches through Ops. You'll take the foundational understanding we have today to the next level — surfacing better ways to manage projects and make data-driven decisions that improve operational efficiency and margin. This position suits a highly analytical, organized, action-oriented leader who is comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-moving environment. This role reports to the Senior Manager, Operations Network Strategy.

One Team: We don’t think of ourselves as “Acquisition Marketers”, “Engineers”, “Data Analysts”, or “Product Managers”. Beyond denoting skill sets and areas of expertise, we don’t think departments matter. We’d rather align ourselves to the goals we’re working to achieve and make sure we have necessary subject matter expertise to drive meaningful impact. We strive to orient ourselves around customer problems TOGETHER – getting the right people, with the right context, in the right rooms/Zooms to solve problems holistically.

We are skeptical about everything and precious about nothing:   Ideas can and should come from anywhere, and we aren’t tied to our own. We proactively source input. We talk to our customers and leads regularly and are quick to change course if we know there’s a better or more impactful way to solve problems.

We consider the customer journey in all of our decisions:   We know that no interaction exists in a silo and therefore understand how important every single one is.  We ensure our strategy sets prospective and new customers up for success and drives long-term retention.  We answer questions and address problems early and proactively.  We understand the value of different channels, initiatives, and messages and know how to articulate impact and advocate for prioritization holistically.

We Execute For Impact: We don’t subscribe to “best practices” or “industry KPIs”. We’re uninterested in how we compare to “benchmarks”; instead we orient ourselves around being the best we can possibly be. Similarly, we don’t subscribe to rigid or classical expectations of roles – i.e. acquisition is hyper-focused on improving customer retention and experience.

We Are Focused and Work Without Assumption : We are not beholden to ideas. We have goals and believe everything beyond that is a series of hypotheses to validate. To that end, we seek to work in sequence and not in parallel. We constantly ask ourselves, “what’s the most important hypothesis I should be working on right now? How do I confirm or reject that hypothesis as fast as possible?”. We rarely have timelines/deadlines and are constantly taking in new information and adjusting our priorities accordingly. We don’t expect to be perfect the first time.

How You'll Make An Impact

- Own complex, cross-functional projects end-to-end across the network — including new product introductions, ingredient changes, cost and capacity optimization, and process improvement initiatives — driving them from concept to completion.

- Lead new product initiatives through Ops. Partner with Commercialization, R&D, and Technical Ops to bring approved products to market across every channel we serve, owning operational readiness end to end: capacity and sourcing requirements, trial planning, production scale-up, launch execution, and post-launch management. Commercialization owns product development and the business case; you own whether Ops can deliver it, on time, at target cost, and at quality.

- Assess and mitigate risk before it lands. Identify operational risks across the project portfolio — capacity shortfalls, single points of failure, supplier and quality exposure. Build the contingency plans that keep commitments intact when conditions change.

- Manage multiple projects simultaneously , ensuring timely delivery and adherence to budget and quality standards.

- Take a leading role in project prioritization relative to strategic company initiatives, building the business cases and feasibility inputs that determine what the network invests in.

- Drive cross-functional alignment and influence outcomes. Lead optimization efforts in partnership with Planning, Procurement, Fulfillment, Technical Operations, Commercialization, Nutrition, Innovation, Growth, and FP&A — documenting, communicating, and presenting supply chain scope, capabilities, and goals, and ensuring project scope, goals, and timelines are clearly defined, agreed to, and met.

- Improve gross margin. Bring a deep understanding of Operational P&Ls and partner with FP&A to identify and act on margin opportunities through strategic procurement and network initiatives.

- Analyze operational performance data — capacity, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost — interpreting trends, patterns, and outliers to surface insights and opportunities for improvement.

- Create and deliver executive-level presentations , clearly communicating project progress, risks, and recommendations to leadership.

- Streamline processes and drive business simplification. Identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks, then partner with cross-functional teams to design and implement improvements using continuous improvement tools and methodologies.

- Build the tools and governance that keep projects on track — stage gates, status reporting, and post-launch reviews that measure whether we delivered what we committed to.

We're Excited About You Because

- You have a BS degree in Management, Supply Chain, or a related field, and 7+ years of experience in supply chain, project management, program management, or related roles, with a focus on direct-to-consumer operations.

- You have in-depth knowledge of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies and tools, and proven experience in continuous improvement project management.

- You have excellent analytics and presentation skills and a proven track record of translating data-driven insight into action and consumer-facing impact.

- You are proficient in data analysis tools and techniques, such as Microsoft Excel, SQL, etc.

- You have clear, confident, and persuasive verbal and written communication skills when working with a diverse group of cross-functional stakeholders.

- You're an owner with excellent problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple deliverables across various timelines.

- You take a proactive approach to overcoming operational challenges.

- You are adaptable and resilient, able to operate autonomously in a dynamic and rapidly evolving business environment.

- You love dogs.

We are seeking individuals who excel in this type of environment, where being present fosters deeper connections and engagement.
